sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Author Wendy Jones highlighted the trend in an Instagram post: ‘What is going on here?’ Nine of the 10 bestselling fiction paperbacks in the UK this week have one thing in common: a woman is murdered. The novels, which appear on this week’s Sunday Times bestseller list , include The Secret of Secrets, The Divorce, The Names , The Family Friend, The Widow, The Impossible Fortune, The Hallmarked Man , My Husband’s Wife and Boleyn Traitor.
